senses.sense_definition: The state of being completely absorbed, preoccupied, or deeply focused on something.

examples.text: Her complete <w>engrossment</w> in the novel made her forget all about the dinner in the oven.
He listened with absolute <w>engrossment</w> as the professor explained the complex scientific theory.

senses.sense_definition: The preparation or writing out of a final, official draft of a legal document ready for signing.

examples.text: The law firm charged a fee for the <w>engrossment</w> of the commercial lease agreement.
Following several revisions, the contract was sent out for final <w>engrossment</w> before execution.

senses.sense_definition: A finalized legal document in its formal, completed text awaiting execution or signature.

examples.text: The solicitor asked all parties to review the <w>engrossment</w> carefully before applying their signatures.
Copies of the <w>engrossment</w> were distributed to the board members for final approval.
